notes: NI Electric Keys / Session Keys Electric ΓÇö electric piano collection covering Rhodes Mark I/II, Wurlitzer, CP-80. Runs in Kontakt. CC 11 Expression controls dynamics. Tremolo rate/depth are the most musical real-time controls.

Expression.description: Expression ΓÇö dynamics control (velocity swell in real time)

Modulation.description: Modulation wheel ΓÇö typically controls tremolo depth

Quick Control 1.description: Instrument Model ΓÇö selects between Rhodes Mk I, Mk II, Wurlitzer, CP-80 (varies by patch)

Quick Control 2.description: Bell/Tine Character ΓÇö balance between bell-like attack and body

Quick Control 4.description: Tremolo Rate ΓÇö speed of built-in tremolo

Quick Control 5.description: Tremolo Depth ΓÇö intensity of tremolo effect

Quick Control 6.description: Reverb Mix ΓÇö built-in reverb amount

Quick Control 7.description: Chorus/Phaser Mix ΓÇö modulation effect amount

Release.description: Release time ΓÇö note decay length
